name: atlassian-mcp
description: Tickets, pull requests, review threads and git context for self-hosted Jira and Bitbucket (Server / Data Center).
long_description:
Exposes Jira Server/Data Center and Bitbucket Server/Data Center as MCP tools: read and write tickets, open and review pull requests, manage comment threads and PR tasks, and read git state for the repository you point it at. Jira Cloud and Bitbucket Cloud are not supported.

Fill in your instance URLs and personal access tokens below, or leave them blank to reuse an existing ~/.atlassian-mcp.json. Set Repository so the git and pull-request tools know which working tree you mean.

jira_url.title: Jira URL
jira_url.description: e.g. https://jira.example.com — self-hosted only. Blank reuses ~/.atlassian-mcp.json.

jira_token.title: Jira personal access token
jira_token.description: Profile → Personal Access Tokens in Jira (8.14+).

bitbucket_url.title: Bitbucket URL
bitbucket_url.description: e.g. https://bitbucket.example.com — self-hosted only. Blank reuses ~/.atlassian-mcp.json.

bitbucket_token.title: Bitbucket personal access token
bitbucket_token.description: Manage account → Personal access tokens in Bitbucket (5.5+).

repo_root.title: Repository
repo_root.description: Working tree the git and pull-request tools default to. Without it, those tools need an explicit repoPath on every call.

git_path.title: git executable (optional)
git_path.description: Only needed if git is not on this app's PATH — common on Windows, e.g. C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe.
